# MeasurementInducedPhaseTransition

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A sharp transition in the entanglement structure of a quantum state driven by the rate of projective measurements, separating volume-law from area-law phases. Enables tunable memory and information retention properties in neuromorphic quantum hardware, directly relevant to reservoir computing dynamics.
